# écentic — AI Agent Commerce Platform
# https://ecentic.ai
# llms.txt v1 — https://llmstxt.org/

## About
écentic is an e-commerce optimization platform for the AI agent economy.
It simulates how AI shopping agents (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) compare
products against competitors, diagnoses why products win or lose, and auto-optimizes
listings with one-click write-back to Shopify and WooCommerce.

## UCP Profile
- https://ecentic.ai/.well-known/ucp — écentic's own Universal Commerce Profile

## Agent access policy
écentic welcomes AI shopping agents, search crawlers, and agentic browsers.
We do not block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, or AppleBot-Extended.
Merchants who use écentic publish structured /.well-known/ucp profiles to improve
AI agent readability of their product data.
